01 — About

Background & focus

What I bring to the table, and how I got here.

I'm a Data Analyst with an academic background in Communication and Computer Engineering from Mansoura University. That foundation gave me a structured, technical way of thinking that I now apply to data — breaking problems down, testing assumptions, and building solutions methodically.

My interest is in data analysis and business intelligence: taking raw, messy datasets and turning them into dashboards, metrics, and recommendations that a business can actually act on.

I'm building this skill set through structured training, hands-on practice, and personal projects using real-world datasets — sales, real estate, automotive, and retail data — rather than tutorials alone.

Starbucks Sales Analysis Dashboard

A Power BI dashboard analyzing sales performance, customer behavior, product performance, payment methods, and store performance.

Key insights
  • Bakery products generated the largest share of sales.
  • Mobile-app customers contributed around half of total sales.
  • Sales were distributed almost equally across the three stores.
  • Identified top-performing and underperforming products.
